mission: M3IV - Detector 0 landmark training packet authority gap review

m3iu_readiness_plan.role: Immediate upstream readiness matrix; records packet not training-ready.

m3iu_validation_receipt.role: Receipt proving M3IU stayed static and selected this M3IV review.

dataset_source_register.role: Current source-rights register reviewed for derived region and hand-landmark authority.

m3iq_validation_receipt.role: Receipt proving M3IQ recorded policy only and did not train, promote, or activate recognition.

m3ir_target_contract.role: Static four-region plus hand-landmark target contract.

m3it_recognizer_sequence_plan.role: Future recognizer sequence contract dependent on separately promoted Detector 0 outputs.

observer_508_model_input_strategy.role: Advisory only; warns against more autonomous training retries without new evidence.

source_register_authority_summary.conclusion: No current source-register record explicitly authorizes offline-derived Detector 0 region boxes and 21-hand-landmark labels for a materialized training or evaluation packet.

candidate_only_records.reason: The register allows first-party clips after clip-level consent and required evidence, but no M3IV packet source list, clip-level consent record, signer registry entry, or explicit region/hand-landmark label scope exists.

raw_video_only_or_derived_artifact_disal.reason: Approval is limited to local raw-RGB training and validation; the register disallows pose outputs, landmarks, feature caches, and derived CV artifacts.
Approval is limited to raw source clips; the register disallows pose/keypoint outputs, bounding boxes as model inputs, crops, feature caches, and derived CV artifacts.
Approval covers original game-category raw video archives; the register states derived pose, landmark, embedding, feature, detector, or pretrained artifacts remain disallowed.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: The future packet has no exact source_id, clip_id, frame_id, signer_id, split, or raw-media reference list.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: A packet-specific source manifest and rights receipt must enumerate every source and raw clip/frame reference before packet materialization.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: The register has no record that explicitly permits offline-derived region boxes and hand-landmark labels for the intended Detector 0 packet.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: A human/source-review receipt must explicitly update each selected source or clip to allow derived region boxes and hand landmarks for training/evaluation supervision.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: The project has the locked offline-label/runtime separation policy, but no future packet metadata binds that policy to any sidecars or sources.
authority_gap_matrix.required_wording: targets offline-derived via MediaPipe Holistic; runtime uses only our scratch-trained model and is not a runtime dependency.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: Any approved future packet must store the exact co-located disclosure wording with the label provenance receipt.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: No raw clip/frame manifest exists for the proposed packet.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: The future manifest must retain source_id, clip_id, frame_id, signer/source identity where applicable, split, frame count, local path, and SHA-256 references without redistributing restricted media.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: No method, version, command, configuration, or sidecar checksum record exists for future offline-derived labels.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: A future approved packet must bind each label sidecar to method/version/config/command hashes and to the approved source-rights decision.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: M3IR and M3IT define target spaces and sequence contracts, but no packet sidecars are available to audit against them.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: After source/label authority exists, a packet audit must prove normalized full-frame region boxes, expanded signing-space crop landmarks, full-frame mapping, target ids, masks, and landmark order compatibility.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: No human/manual review sample exists for region boxes, hand landmarks, negatives, no-hand frames, occlusions, truncation, or off-center cases.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: A future packet needs reviewer identity or role, review date, sample selection rules, acceptance criteria, and issue disposition before training/evaluation evidence can be trusted.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: The future packet has no negative/no-hand source accounting or split counts.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: A future packet needs source-approved negative/no-hand manifests with counts by source and split plus expected false-trigger and false-no-hand metrics.

authority_gap_matrix.finding: Current claim surfaces remain fail-closed: no trained Detector 0, no browser artifact, no active recognition labels, and no browser recognition activation.
authority_gap_matrix.required_decision_or_evidence: No further decision is needed to preserve fail-closed status. Separate validated promotion evidence would be required before any future claim expansion.

before_packet_materialization: Exact packet source list with source_id, clip_id, frame_id, signer/source identity where available, split, and local raw-media hash references.
Per-source or per-clip source-rights receipt explicitly allowing offline-derived region boxes and hand landmarks for training/evaluation supervision.
First-party clip-level consent and signer registry evidence if first-party-browser-consent-capture is selected.
before_offline_labeler_run: Human/source approval that the selected raw source may receive derived region and hand-landmark labels.
Label provenance disclosure using the exact required wording.
Method/version/config/command sidecar contract and checksum plan.
before_tensor_generation_training_or_eva: Raw clip/frame manifest and checksum manifest.
Label sidecar checksum manifest bound to source-rights receipts.
Coordinate compatibility audit against M3IR and M3IT.
before_brev_spend_export_promotion_brows: Separate explicit human approval for bounded compute if Brev is needed.
Training/evaluation/export receipts from approved packet inputs.
Promotion evidence satisfying existing final gates without changing those gates.

loop_decision.reason: The current local evidence already identifies the controlling gap: no source-register record explicitly grants derived region/hand-landmark label authority for a materialized packet. Further packet, tensor, training, or materialization contracts would be speculative until a human/source authority decision exists.
